scope: Planning appendix for named content illustrations and glyphs only; not the complete UI, board or effects asset inventory. No game data or runtime behavior is changed.

priority_meaning.P1current: Current playable content or shared immediate presentation; production still waits for identity/style acceptance.
priority_meaning.P2pilot: Optional art-pilot illustration, deferred until approved models/forms. Does not imply gameplay enablement.
priority_meaning.P3future: Disabled gameplay, future presentation or optional later illustration; requires separate design/production acceptance.

reference_packet.REF03: Icon and portrait grammar reference only, not approved. Generic sample objects do not add relics to the catalogue.
reference_packet.REF04: Effects grammar reference only, not approved.

counting.rule: Each asset row is one logical master. Each runtime_sizes entry is one derived export. Composed states, source layers and grayscale proof thumbnails add no illustration master; optional/deferred rows are included in totals. A vector-authored row retains vector source in addition to listed raster canvas exports.
